title: Locally constant perfect condensed-coefficient complexes
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed coefficient ring, $S$ a scheme, and $P\in D(S_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda_S)$ in the ambient relative module derived category of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Define $P$ to be locally constant perfect if there is a pro-étale covering family $\{U_i\to S\}$ such that, for each $i$, there is a bounded cochain complex $F_i$ of condensed $\Lambda$-modules on the point whose every term is a retract of a finite free $\Lambda$-module, and an isomorphism $P|_{U_i}\simeq Q(F_i\otimes_\Lambda\Lambda_{U_i})$, with scalar extension applied termwise. Use the finite-free retracts and canonical termwise point pullback of [lem-sfb-internal-hom-dual-tor-amplitude]. Equivalently these are the scalar extensions of bounded complexes of finite projective $\Lambda(*)$-modules of [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] and [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]: finite-free maps and their retracts on the condensed point are matrices over $\Lambda(*)$. The bounds may depend on the cover member; the covering family may be empty when $S$ is empty.
